parameters.help_en:
Watermark type. Valid values:

PureWebappInvisible: Web watermark.

PureAppInvisible: App watermark.

PureScreenInvisible: Screen watermark.

AigcWebappInvisible: AIGC web watermark.

AigcAppInvisible: AIGC app watermark.

AigcScreenInvisible: AIGC screen watermark
parameters.help_zh:
水印类型。取值：
PureWebappInvisible：网页水印。
PureAppInvisible：App水印。
PureScreenInvisible：屏幕水印。
AigcWebappInvisible：AIGC网页水印。
AigcAppInvisible：AIGC App水印。
AigcScreenInvisible：AIGC屏幕水印
parameters.name: wm_type

parameters.help_en: Bit width of the watermark information. Default value: 32. This value must be the same during embedding and extraction. For example, if you use a 40-bit SDK to embed the watermark, set this value to 40 when extracting it
parameters.help_zh: 水印信息的容量位宽，默认为32。该参数嵌入和提取时需要保持一致。比如嵌入时使用的是 40 位的SDK，那么提取时也需要将该值设为 40
parameters.name: wm_info_size

parameters.help_en:
Decimal-form watermark information. Do not set this parameter if you set WmInfoBytesB64.

The valid range depends on the WmInfoSize value:

If WmInfoSize is 32, the valid range is 1 to 4294967295.

If WmInfoSize is 40, the valid range is 1 to 1099511627775.

If WmInfoSize is 64, the valid range is 1 to 18446744073709551615
parameters.help_zh:
10进制数字格式水印信息。若设置该值，则 WmInfoBytesB64 不能设置。

取值范围取决于  WmInfoSize 参数：

当 WmInfoSize 为32时，取值范围为 1~4294967295。

当 WmInfoSize 为40时，取值范围为 1~1099511627775。

当 WmInfoSize 为64时，取值范围为 1~18446744073709551615
parameters.name: wm_info_uint

parameters.help_en: Base64-encoded watermark information. Length: 1 to 300 characters. Do not set this parameter if you set WmInfoUint
parameters.help_zh: Base64编码后的字符串格式水印信息 。长度1～300个字符。若设置该值，则 WmInfoUint 参数不能设置
parameters.name: wm_info_bytes_b64

parameters.help_en: Scaling factor of the watermark image
parameters.name: scale

parameters.help_en: Width of the watermark image, in pixels. Valid values: 100 to 5000
parameters.help_zh: 水印图片的宽度，单位为像素。取值：100~5000
parameters.name: width

parameters.help_en: Height of the watermark image, in pixels. Valid values: 100 to 5000
parameters.help_zh: 水印图片的高度，单位为像素。取值：100~5000
parameters.name: height

parameters.help_en: Opacity of the watermark image. Valid values: 1 to 255. Higher values mean lower transparency
parameters.help_zh: 水印图片的透明度。取值：1~255。取值越大，透明度越低
parameters.name: opacity

fields.help_en: Text watermark content. Format: UTF-8 string
fields.help_zh: 文本水印文案。格式为utf8字符串
fields.name: visible_text

fields.help_en:
Text watermark display mode. Valid values:

pos: Fixed position mode.

repeat: Tiled mode
fields.help_zh:
文本水印显示模式。取值：
pos：固定位置模式。
repeat：平铺模式
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: Text watermark opacity. Valid values: 1 to 255. Higher values mean less transparency
fields.help_zh: 文本水印透明度。取值：1~255。取值越大，越不透明
fields.name: opacity

fields.help_en: Font size of the text watermark. Larger values produce larger fonts
fields.help_zh: 文本水印文字字号。取值越大，字体越大
fields.name: font_size

fields.help_en: Text watermark color. Format: RGB, such as 0xFFFFFF or #FFFFFF. For example, 0x000000 or #000000 means black
fields.help_zh: 文本水印文字颜色。格式为 0xFFFFFF或#FFFFFF RGB颜色格式。如 0x000000或#000000 表示黑色
fields.name: font_color

fields.help_en: Rotation angle of the text watermark, in degrees clockwise. Valid values: 0 to 360
fields.help_zh: 文本水印文字顺针旋转角度。取值范围0~360
fields.name: angle

fields.help_en: Takes effect only when Mode is pos. Horizontal position of the text watermark, measured in pixels from the top-left corner
fields.help_zh: Mode为pos时生效。控制文本水印水平位置的参数，以左上角为原点的像素位置控制
fields.name: pos_x

fields.help_en: Takes effect only when Mode is pos. Vertical position of the text watermark, measured in pixels from the top-left corner
fields.help_zh: Mode为pos时生效。控制文本水印垂直位置的参数，以左上角为原点的像素位置控制
fields.name: pos_y

fields.help_en: Takes effect only when Mode is repeat. Horizontal spacing between repeated text watermarks
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。控制文本水印平铺水平间距的参数
fields.name: space_x

fields.help_en: Takes effect only when Mode is repeat. Vertical spacing between repeated text watermarks
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。控制文本水印平铺垂直间距的参数
fields.name: space_y

fields.help_en: Horizontal anchor point for the text watermark. Valid values: 0 to 1. When (PosAx, PosAy) is (0, 0), the top-left corner of the text is used as the anchor point. When it is 0.5, the center point is used. When it is (1, 1), the bottom-right corner is used
fields.help_zh:
文本水印水平方向锚点。
取值范围0~1。(PosAx,PosAy)取值为（0,0）时，以文本左上角为锚点绘制；取值为0.5，以文本中心点位置绘制；取值为（1,1）时，以文本右下角位置绘制
fields.name: pos_ax

fields.help_en: Vertical anchor point for the text watermark. Valid values: 0 to 1. When (PosAx, PosAy) is (0, 0), the top-left corner of the text is used as the anchor point. When it is 0.5, the center point is used. When it is (1, 1), the bottom-right corner is used
fields.help_zh:
文本水印垂直方向锚点。
取值范围0~1。(PosAx,PosAy)取值为（0,0）时，以文本左上角为锚点绘制；取值为0.5，以文本中心点位置绘制；取值为（1,1）时，以文本右下角位置绘制
fields.name: pos_ay

fields.help_en:
Visibility setting:

true: Show the watermark.

false: Hide the watermark
fields.help_zh:
可见性：

true ：  显示

false： 不显示

fields.help_en: Takes effect only when Mode is top-left or top-right. Top margin
fields.help_zh: Mode为top-left、top-right时生效。上边距
fields.name: top

fields.help_en: Takes effect only when Mode is top-right or bottom-right. Right margin
fields.help_zh: Mode为top-right、bottom-right时生效。右边距
fields.name: right

fields.help_en: Takes effect only when Mode is bottom-left or bottom-right. Bottom margin
fields.help_zh: Mode为bottom-left、bottom-right时生效。下边距
fields.name: bottom

fields.help_en: Takes effect only when Mode is top-left or bottom-left. Left margin
fields.help_zh: Mode为top-left、bottom-left时生效。左边距
fields.name: left

fields.help_en: Takes effect only when Mode is top-left, top-right, bottom-left, or bottom-right. Margin settings
fields.help_zh: Mode为top-left、top-right、bottom-left、bottom-right时生效。边距

fields.help_en: Text watermark control parameters
fields.help_zh: 图片文本水印控制参数
fields.name: text_visible_control

fields.help_en: Enable enhanced visible logo watermark. If enabled, the logo is converted into a watermark and added to the image
fields.help_zh: 是否开启增强明水印。开启后logo会被转换为水印logo，添加到图片上
fields.name: enhance

fields.help_en: Base64-encoded logo watermark. The logo file must be a PNG image encoded in Base64 format
fields.help_zh: Base64格式logo水印。Logo文件为PNG图片转成Base64格式
fields.name: logo_base64

fields.help_en:
The display mode for the logo watermark. Valid values:

pos: Fixed position pattern.

repeat: Tile pattern
fields.help_zh:
Logo水印显示模式。取值：
pos：固定位置模式。
repeat：平铺模式
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: Logo watermark opacity. Valid values: 1 to 255. A higher value means lower transparency
fields.help_zh: Logo水印透明度。取值：1~255。取值越大，透明度越低
fields.name: opacity

fields.help_en: The clockwise rotation angle of the logo watermark text. Valid values: 1 to 360
fields.help_zh: Logo水印文字顺针旋转角度。取值范围1~360
fields.name: angle

fields.help_en: Takes effect when Mode is set to pos. This parameter controls the horizontal position of a visible watermark, using pixel coordinates with the top-left corner as the origin
fields.help_zh: Mode为pos时生效。控制明水印水平位置的参数，以左上角为原点的像素位置控制
fields.name: pos_x

fields.help_en: Specifies the vertical position of the visible watermark in pixels. The top-left corner is the origin. This parameter is valid only when Mode is set to pos
fields.help_zh: Mode为pos时生效。控制明水印垂直位置的参数，以左上角为原点的像素位置控制
fields.name: pos_y

fields.help_en: This parameter takes effect when Mode is set to repeat. It specifies the horizontal pitch for the tiled visible watermark
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。控制明水印平铺水平间距的参数
fields.name: space_x

fields.help_en: Applies only when Mode is set to repeat. Controls the vertical pitch between tiled visible watermarks
fields.help_zh: Mode为repeat时生效。控制明水印平铺垂直间距的参数
fields.name: space_y

fields.help_en: The horizontal anchor point for the logo watermark. Valid values: 0 to 1. When (PosAx, PosAy) is (0, 0), the watermark anchors to the top-left corner of the text. When the value is 0.5, the watermark anchors to the centroid of the text. When (PosAx, PosAy) is (1, 1), the watermark anchors to the bottom-right corner of the text
fields.help_zh: Logo水印水平方向锚点。 取值范围0~1。(PosAx,PosAy)取值为（0,0）时，以文本左上角为锚点绘制；取值为0.5，以文本中心点位置绘制；取值为（1,1）时，以文本右下角位置绘制
fields.name: pos_ax

fields.help_en: The vertical anchor point for the logo watermark. The value ranges from 0 to 1. The coordinates (PosAx, PosAy) define the anchor point on the watermark. For example, (0,0) represents the top-left corner, (0.5, 0.5) represents the centroid, and (1,1) represents the bottom-right corner
fields.help_zh: Logo水印垂直方向锚点。 取值范围0~1。(PosAx,PosAy)取值为（0,0）时，以文本左上角为锚点绘制；取值为0.5，以文本中心点位置绘制；取值为（1,1）时，以文本右下角为位置绘制
fields.name: pos_ay
